svg.title: ArqUX: governed work from agents to reviewed lessons
svg.desc: Agents A, B and C feed two governed projects. Each project retains criterion, context, decisions and evidence, and runs a define, implement and verify cycle. Reviewed lessons accumulate as knowledge and flow back to the agents as standard reading.

g.aria-label: Project A: what governs project work
Project B: what governs project work
Reviewed lessons: what the project retains
